name: Grade 8 IIIT Practice: September Week 3 - User Needs
description: Practice words for Grade 8 third-trimester app, Python, and Micro:bit work.

words.definition: What users need from a product.
words.example: User needs showed that players wanted clear instructions.

words.definition: The users or classmates who will try the app and give feedback.
words.example: The audience was students who would try the app in class.

words.definition: A useful part of an app or product.
words.example: A restart button was added as a useful feature.

words.definition: Rules that show whether something works well.
words.example: Success criteria said the app needed clear controls and working scoring.

words.definition: A diagram showing events and screen flow.
words.example: The event map connected the start, play, and results screens.

words.definition: A planned test with expected behavior.
words.example: The test case checked what happened after a wrong answer.

words.definition: A simple layout plan for a screen.
words.example: The wireframe planned the layout before the app was built.
